description: This file defines the AuthService class responsible for handling user authentication, session management, and wizard status checks in a web application. It includes methods for login, session handling, and wizard requirement checks, utilizing mock data in development and real API calls in production.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Singleton class managing user authentication, session persistence, and wizard status.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AuthService.

methods.name: setSessionId
methods.description: Sets the current session ID and stores it in localStorage.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the session ID and related localStorage items.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if a user is currently authenticated based on session ID.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, handling mock data in development and API call in production, and checks wizard status.

methods.name: needsWizard
methods.description: Determines if the wizard setup is required based on localStorage flag.

methods.name: clearWizardFlag
methods.description: Removes the wizard requirement flag from localStorage.
